description: Let a published version age 5 days before proposing it, so a compromised publish has time to be yanked. Keep in sync with minimumReleaseAge in pnpm-workspace.yaml, which is set in minutes.
internalChecksFilter 'strict' is already the default; it is pinned here so it cannot drift to 'flexible' or 'none', which would weaken or disable the age gate.

The vulnerabilityAlerts override below does NOT currently take effect: 'strict' drops the too-fresh patched release during datasource lookup, before the vulnerabilityAlerts config is merged, so a [SECURITY] PR can target a version that is still vulnerable. See renovatebot/renovate#44065. Verify the target version of a [SECURITY] PR by hand until that is fixed; the override is kept so the behaviour corrects itself automatically.
